domainModelPath.description: Path to the domain model markdown file. Required when metadataPath is not provided.

metadataPath.description: Optional path to an existing metadata JSON file. When provided, markdown parsing is skipped.

metadataOutputPath.description: Optional output path for generated metadata JSON when markdown parsing runs.

entityFilter.description: Comma-separated list of entity names to focus markdown parsing on (optional).

schemaOutputPath.description: Optional output path for generated SQL DDL. When provided, the dispatcher invokes domain-model-sql-generator.
